claims.claim: Infleqtion's 2025 Form 10-K explicitly states that it had demonstrated 12 logical qubits while targeting 100 logical qubits by 2028, and that scaling neutral-atom systems can be impaired by qubit fidelity, logical-to-physical scaling, atom interconnection, manufacturing and cost/performance constraints. These are source-addressed execution falsifiers rather than evidence that failure has already occurred.

The same filing states Infleqtion has a history of operating losses, expects substantial additional capital needs, relies on third-party and sole-source suppliers for components, and faces competition from large technology companies and other quantum modalities. Alpha can therefore treat financing durability, supply concentration and substitution/competitive response as evidenced downside dimensions without Beta assigning a numeric risk score.

Infleqtion also states that Superstaq depends on public clouds operated by Google Cloud and AWS, whose owners have competing quantum efforts and could bundle competing products or alter commercial terms; this is a concrete platform-dependence risk and a falsifier for assumptions of unconstrained distribution leverage.

risks.risk: Additional capital may be required before scalable commercial economics are proven; financing terms and dilution remain Alpha-owned quantitative underwriting questions.
Sole-source component dependencies and undeveloped high-volume manufacturing processes can delay delivery or raise costs.
Cloud partners with competing quantum efforts can change distribution economics or favor competing offerings.

contradictions.contradiction: Commercialization progress and partnerships coexist with issuer-disclosed technical, manufacturing, financing and platform-dependence risks.
contradictions.disposition: stage-consistent tension; quantify through Alpha underwriting rather than treating as a present blocker

unknowns.unknown: Current post-Q2 cash runway, dilution sensitivity and customer concentration require Alpha's current numeric underwriting.
Whether newer 2026 technical milestones materially reduce the 10-K's disclosed scaling and manufacturing risks requires independent technical/customer validation.
